classification.difficultyReason: Choose the triangle angle sum or exterior-angle theorem, express the relationship as a linear equation, and collect terms and solve. The hardest part first transfers a vertically opposite angle before forming the equation.

content.prompt: Find $\alpha$, $\beta$, $\gamma$ and $\theta$ in these diagrams, giving reasons.

spec.description: Triangle ABC with right angle at A and angle labels alpha at B and 5 alpha at C. Ordinary source blue strokes are rendered black.
spec.mathematics: Angle A is 90 degrees; angle B is alpha; angle C is 5 alpha.

spec.description: Triangle XYZ with horizontal YZ; angle labels alpha, 2 alpha and 3 alpha.
spec.mathematics: Angles at X, Y and Z are alpha, 2 alpha and 3 alpha respectively.

spec.description: Triangle PRQ with 112 degrees at R, beta at Q and curved leader from beta plus 15 degrees to the interior angle at P.
spec.mathematics: Angle P is beta plus 15 degrees, angle R is 112 degrees and angle Q is beta.

spec.description: Triangle DAR with RA extended through A to C and exterior angle CAD labelled 2 alpha.
spec.mathematics: Interior angles at D and R are 32 and 48 degrees; R, A, C are collinear.

spec.description: Triangle IFS with horizontal IS extended to H, theta at I and F, and exterior angle 124 degrees at S.
spec.mathematics: I, S, H are collinear; the two opposite interior angles both equal theta.

spec.description: Triangle LJK with vertical LJ and horizontal JK; no right-angle marker is added.
spec.mathematics: Angles at L, J and K are 3 theta, 5 theta and 2 theta.

spec.description: Triangle IWS with both sloping sides extended across W to Y and T; 46 degrees is above the crossing, with beta at both base vertices.
spec.mathematics: I, W, Y and S, W, T are collinear; angle TWY is 46 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: The vertically opposite interior angle is not supplied.

answer.short:
$\beta=67^\circ$

Use vertically opposite angles, then the triangle angle sum.
answer.worked:
$\angle IWS=46^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles at $W$).

Angle sum of $\triangle IWS$:
$$\begin{align*}\beta+\beta+46^\circ&=180^\circ\\2\beta&=134^\circ\\\beta&=67^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Triangle SUT on horizontal RST with exterior angle 140 degrees at S, 9 gamma at U and gamma at T.
spec.mathematics: R, S, T are collinear; the exterior angle equals the sum of 9 gamma and gamma.
